title: fix: show how to set up secure access when Connect a device can't make a code
body:
Fixes #202045

## What Problem This Solves

A Gateway on a new install accepts connections only from its own computer. When an owner tries to create their first phone setup code, the dialog reports a configuration error and leaves them to figure out how to make the Gateway reachable.

## User Impact

**Connect a device** guides phone pairing through **Set up secure access** and announces that title to screen readers. Choose Tailscale Serve, a trusted home network, or an existing public HTTPS address. **Device** pairing keeps its existing setup error and **Reload** action.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Gateway sends a structured detail for the loopback refusal and keeps the error message available to the CLI and other setup flows. The Dashboard uses the detail only for phone pairing and keeps the instructions outside the title’s live region.

The Dashboard leaves configuration changes to the owner. Tailscale Serve keeps the Gateway on loopback and encrypts connections. The trusted-home-network option opens a plaintext LAN listener and explains how to undo it. Phone codes created over plaintext LAN have Limited access, which includes chat history and approvals.

## Evidence

Built the Control UI and ran Chromium against isolated Gateways on Roobook with synthetic credentials and unrelated plugins disabled. The comparison uses `main` at `4eb94c89588f` and this PR at `05317529cc37`.

| Setup | Main | This PR |
| --- | --- | --- |

| Device on loopback | ![Device setup shows its existing error](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daniel-lxs/screenshots/eac5096e9bf0719d5862337ccd5a394692096080/images/2026/11/585e7da0-9cff-48e1-92ef-010387f9284c.png) | ![Device setup keeps its existing error](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daniel-lxs/screenshots/eac5096e9bf0719d5862337ccd5a394692096080/images/2026/11/4359255f-67db-4a52-96e0-9148527ed061.png) |

| Setup | Main with callouts | This PR with callouts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Phone on loopback | ![The error is the announcement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daniel-lxs/screenshots/eac5096e9bf0719d5862337ccd5a394692096080/images/2026/11/5a3b700c-0f52-4f79-a087-a06156985e8e.png) | ![The live region contains only the title](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daniel-lxs/screenshots/eac5096e9bf0719d5862337ccd5a394692096080/images/2026/11/d1b03400-7188-40c1-89c5-d8520f7b849f.png) |
| Device on loopback | ![The selected Device setup shows the error](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daniel-lxs/screenshots/eac5096e9bf0719d5862337ccd5a394692096080/images/2026/11/d5035070-3a7c-45eb-8780-6c85187ae53f.png) | ![The selected Device setup still shows the error](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daniel-lxs/screenshots/eac5096e9bf0719d5862337ccd5a394692096080/images/2026/11/70527fae-a891-43d0-9864-75cc38cd45c7.png) |

Chromium’s accessibility tree showed a polite live region containing only **Set up secure access** after **Create setup code**.

Opened **Use your home Wi‑Fi instead**, applied the displayed `gateway.bind lan` command, and restarted the isolated Gateway. The same Dashboard tab reconnected. Reopening **Connect a device** and creating a code returned **Limited access** even with Full access selected. The QR and LAN address are masked in the capture.

![Limited access shown on the setup code screen after LAN restart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daniel-lxs/screenshots/eac5096e9bf0719d5862337ccd5a394692096080/images/2026/11/9f0e8308-1462-4129-b477-9a6e57696faa.png)

- 70 focused tests passed across the Gateway setup-code handler, device setup state, and dialog. The Device error and phone announcement regressions fail without the dialog fix.
- UI and core typechecks, protocol, i18n, controller guard, lint, formatter, and production UI builds passed.
- Main and the PR build emitted the same five budget warnings. Compared with main, New Session boot JS was 535 B larger gzip, Chat boot JS was 413 B larger, and total CSS was 6,460 B smaller. Boot request counts matched.
- Codex autoreview found no actionable findings through P2 in the dialog fix.
- Skipped screen-reader playback, Tailscale Serve end to end, and the full UI and Gateway suites.
